fields.name: region
fields.description: Sales region of the customer's billing address (North, South, East, West, Central)

fields.name: age
fields.description: Account holder age in completed years at the snapshot date (18-85)

fields.name: plan
fields.description: Mobile price plan tier: Basic, Standard, Premium or Unlimited

fields.name: contract
fields.description: Contract term: Monthly (rolling), One-Year or Two-Year commitment

fields.name: tenure_months
fields.description: Whole months between start_date and end_date (churned) or the 2026-06-30 snapshot (active)

fields.name: products_held
fields.description: Products on the account (multi-select): mobile, broadband, tv, landline, protection; empty means a dormant account

fields.name: monthly_spend
fields.description: Average monthly bill in USD over the last three billed months; 0 for dormant accounts with no products

fields.name: support_contacts
fields.description: Support calls and chats logged in the last 12 months, capped at 15

fields.name: frequent_caller
fields.description: Operational flag set when support_contacts is 4 or more

fields.name: autopay
fields.description: 1 when the bill is paid by automatic card or bank debit

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: Date the customer's current account was opened

fields.name: end_date
fields.description: Date the account was closed; null while the account is active

fields.name: churned
fields.description: 1 when the account closed between 2024-07-01 and the 2026-06-30 snapshot

fields.name: u_contract
fields.description: Helper: the draw behind contract

fields.name: spend_noise
fields.description: Helper: bill-to-bill variation in monthly_spend, USD

fields.name: extra_contacts
fields.description: Helper: the extra contacts of a customer having a bad year

fields.name: dormant
fields.description: Helper: account holds no product

fields.name: has_mobile
fields.description: Helper: mobile option

fields.name: has_broadband
fields.description: Helper: broadband option

fields.name: has_tv
fields.description: Helper: tv option (sold only over broadband)

fields.name: has_landline
fields.description: Helper: landline option

fields.name: has_protection
fields.description: Helper: protection option

fields.name: n_products
fields.description: Helper: number of products held

fields.name: p_churn
fields.description: Helper: true probability that the account closed in the two-year window

set_expr.contract: u_contract < min(0.9, max(0.2, 0.62 - 0.008 * (age - 44))) ? "Monthly" : u_contract < 1 - min(0.5, max(0.03, 0.13 + 0.005 * (age - 44))) ? "One-Year" : "Two-Year"

set_expr.monthly_spend: dormant == 1 ? 0 : round(100 * max(5, {"Basic": 28, "Standard": 38, "Premium": 54, "Unlimited": 70}[plan] + 6 * has_mobile + 30 * has_broadband + 24 * has_tv + 12 * has_landline + 10 * has_protection + spend_noise)) / 100
